verdict.rationale: LangSmith provides official Python, TypeScript, Go, and Java SDKs (langsmith-docs-24), with GitHub SDK repo showing usage examples (langsmith-gh-1), plus OpenTelemetry support and an official MCP server for agentic integration (langsmith-docs-11, langsmith-probe-4).
